subject: Private POC: sandbox subsidy, egress constraints & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Alice Garner <alice.garner@medorahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medorahealth.com, procurement@medorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits & controls for Private POC

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — Medora is ready to run a 6-week Private/VPC POC for our clinician documentation workload but we have a few security gating items before we can spin up. High level:

- We need a sandbox credit allocation to cover an isolated pilot (estimated token usage ~35k) and a one-time 30-day extension if we need extra cycles.
- Outbound egress controls: all model calls must only go to our VPC endpoints and any external telemetry needs to be allowlisted to a small set of IPs.
- Evidence: recent SOC 2 Type II report, network egress diagram, and confirmation of ephemeral key rotation.
- Procurement needs a simple statement-of-work and an MSA addendum for isolated capacity + billing cap.

Attached is our SSO/identity checklist and a short list of questions from our security team. Can Redwood accommodate a sponsorship/credit arrangement for the POC and provide the items above? If yes, what are next steps and timeline?

Best,
Alice
Alice Garner
VP Product Operations, Medora Health
[Attachment: medora_sso_requirements.pdf (pdf)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Garner <alice.garner@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & controls for Private POC

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely support an isolated Private POC and sponsor credits to get you started. Proposed plan is below: 

- Credit sponsorship: up to $12k of usage credit (approx ~40k tokens depending on workload) initially, with a one-time extension if the pilot needs more time after the 6-week window.
- Security artifacts: we'll provide our current SOC 2 Type II cover letter and network egress diagram within 48 hours.
- Technical controls: we can enforce VPC-only ingress/egress for the pilot and add outbound allowlist for the telemetry endpoints you provide.
- Procurement: we can produce a short SOW and an MSA addendum that limits the trial to the isolated pool and includes a billing cap.

Dev and Markus — looping you both for tech and commercial sign-off. 

Alice — if that sounds good, please confirm an initial start date (we can target Jun 16) and I will send the SOW and DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_poc_sow_stub.docx (docx)]
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & controls for Private POC

Soojin — quick tech notes for the record (tagging for what we'll present to Medora):

1) Egress: we will provision the pilot in an isolated tenant with NAT restricted to the allowlist. Any telemetry calls from the control plane can be routed through a regional collector IP we can provide; we need Medora to provide the exact CIDR/IPs they want allowlisted.

2) Keys: we'll issue short-lived tokens with automatic rotation; customer can require HSM-backed secrets for the Private deployment if they need it.

3) Logging & audit: full request/response audit logs can be delivered to a customer-owned S3/GCS bucket behind the VPC endpoint; retention settings configurable per the SOW.

4) Credits: recommend we allocate an initial 35k-token equivalent credit pool and then allow a one-off top-up upon receipt of a short justification from the customer. Keeps upside limited while they validate.

If Medora confirms the allowlist and start date, engineering can carve a sandbox pool and provide the collector IPs by EOD Jun 11.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Infra & Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Garner <alice.garner@medorahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@medorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & controls for Private POC

Hi Alice / Soojin — commercial note:

- We can proceed with a short SOW and an MSA addendum that covers the isolated pilot and the $12k credit sponsorship.
- For procurement: we'll use a DocuSign wrapper for the SOW + addendum; once signed we'll activate the private pool.
- Billing cap: Medora will not be invoiced beyond the cap unless explicitly agreed in writing.

Soojin — if you want to send the DocuSign link to Alice we should capture the PO or a purchase acknowledgement from procurement to speed activation.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Contracts, Redwood Inference

3) Dev: please stand by to provide the collector IPs and key rotation cadence once we receive the signed SOW.
